arguments.recommended_next_step: Continue monitoring the pgbouncer service and ensure its health. Once the failed_jobs export is complete, proceed with the postmortem analysis. If no improvement is seen, consider restarting the pgbouncer service.
arguments.summary: The postgreSQL service (pgbouncer) is currently degraded, with no worker throughput. The failed_jobs backlog has been growing all week, indicating potential issues with job processing. The export of the failed_jobs table using pg_dump is in progress and is expected to take approximately 20 minutes.
